title: 'Comprehensive closure': Israel to shut down all West Bank crossings, Wafa reports
snippet: 'Comprehensive closure': Israel to shut down all West Bank crossings, Wafa reports Israeli forces have tightened restrictions around the occupied West Bank city of Ramallah, closing roads and entrances to several towns and villages, Wafa news agency reported. The development comes after Israeli authorities decided to impose a “comprehensive closure” on the occupied West Bank and close crossings into the territory until Saturday for the Jewish holiday of Sukkot. title: Avaliação negativa do STF sobe para 47% e bate recorde, aponta Datafolha

Entre eleitores de Lula (PT), 32% consideram o trabalho dos ministros ótimo ou bom, ante 6% dos eleitores de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Na avaliação negativa, o padrão se inverte: 69% dos eleitores de Flávio consideram o trabalho ruim ou péssimo, ante 24% dos eleitores de Lula.
